messages:
Alex K: Quick question on /v1/generation header semantics. If a request includes a valid org-scoped API key but omits X-Project, do we 400, 401, or 403? Trying to align API contract for SDKs.
Priya S: Right now the service falls back to org-scope when X-Project is missing. That was a deliberate convenience but it's causing ambiguity. 401 is for bad/expired token. 403 is for valid token but forbidden for the requested resource. 400 could surface client-side mistakes fast.
Jamie T: Saw a real-world bug where frontend forgot to set X-Project and we billed the wrong project. Repro:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123
# no X-Project header
POST /v1/generation
```
We ended up attributing usage to a default project which confused billing and audits.
Marta L: Yikes. For multi-tenant customers that's a big problem. Tests on our side assume explicit project header for project-scoped keys.
Leo N: Proposal: make rules strict and explicit:
- missing scoping header -> 400 Bad Request with error code `missing_scoping_header` and human-friendly detail
- invalid/expired token -> 401 Unauthorized
- token valid but not permitted for project -> 403 Forbidden
This makes remediation straightforward for integrators.
Alex K: I prefer 400 for missing header instead of silent fallback. SDKs can catch and pre-populate header.
Priya S: Implementation caveat: some public SDKs depend on the fallback today. We should feature-flag the change and run a deprecation/migration period.
Jamie T: Suggest migration mode: when flag ON, log a deprecation audit event for requests that relied on fallback but continue to accept them for 30 days. After that, flip to strict 400. Will add tests.
Marta L: I'll add a matrix comparing behaviors: current, migration, strict. CC @Jamie T to wire up test cases for org-only, project-bound, and service tokens.
InfraBot: key-rotation-job: next rotation window 2026-04-02T03:00Z; will respect grace_window parameter.
Leo N: Rotations: ensure new keys carry scoping metadata. During migration we should allow a short grace window (e.g., 2 hours) where old keys still use org fallback only. Also ensure rotation audit logs map old->new key IDs.
Alex K: Error payload shape suggestion:
```
{ "error": "missing_scoping_header", "detail": "Include X-Project or X-Org. See https://redwood.dev/docs/auth#scoping" }
```
Keep `error` a stable machine string for SDKs to detect. Add `suggestion` field so SDKs can attempt autofill.
Priya S: Agreed on stable code strings. Also add a short `migration_hint` field during migration mode so clients know when strict mode will land.
Jamie T: PR #4213 implements the header validation + feature flag and includes the streaming endpoint behavior. Need one eng-platform review and one infra review. @Marta L can you review the tests? @Leo N can you validate rotation interactions?
Marta L: Will review today and add integration tests covering websocket/stream streaming endpoints (start-of-stream chunk should contain structured error when missing header).
Leo N: I'll add a rotation smoke task that validates new keys include scoping metadata and that the audit trail includes old->new mappings.
Alex K: Rollout checklist I propose:
1) land PR behind flag (flag default: off)
2) enable migration mode for 30 days, collect deprecation audit logs
3) send SDK and customer comms with examples and timeline
4) flip to strict 400, monitor error rates and escalation channels for 48 hours
Also allowlist internal service tokens during migration so infra jobs don't break.
Priya S: I'll build a dashboard to count potentially impacted requests (requests with missing header that used org fallback). Use that to pick a safe rollout date.
Jamie T: Note for streaming: streaming endpoints should emit a protocol-compatible error chunk right at the start and then close the stream. I'll add that to the PR.
Alex K: Action items:
- Jamie: finish PR #4213, include allowlist code path and streaming error behavior
- Marta: review tests + add integration matrix
- Leo: rotation smoke and audit mapping validation
- Priya: dashboard + customer/SKD comms draft
I'll follow up with a short RFC in docs repo after approvals. Thanks :thumbsup:
Marta L: One more: ensure error codes and strings are documented in open API spec and the SDKs are updated to map codes to exceptions.
Jamie T: Noted, will include OpenAPI update in the PR.
Alex K: TL;DR: missing scoping header -> 400; invalid token -> 401; unauthorized -> 403. Migration mode + 30d grace; PR #4213. Ping me for escalations.
